description: Austin, TX – House Bill 3510, authored by State Representative Trey Wharton (HD 12), passed bothchambers of the Texas Legislature unanimously and is now awaiting the signature of Governor GregAbbott. The bill designates a portion of State Highway 6, between College Station and Navasota, as the“Sergeant Mark Butler Memorial Highway” in honor of the fallen…
title: RELEASE: Wharton Bill Honoring Navasota Sergeant Mark Butler Advances to Governor - Trey Wharton For Texas State Representative District 12
